items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: So she told us where he was, and we went and found him

ctx.x: He said it hurt him to do it.

Yeah, we was lookin' for Les to come on to play in the show, and his horn was there, but ain't nobody seen him. He didn't show up. He left. But this chick knew where he was -- Clara. She knew where he was. I mean, a good-lookin' chick, I can't think of her last name. Clara. Anyway, she was kind of (?) with Les. But she was older than Les. She was about in her twenties, and Les was about 17 or something like that. So she told us where he was, and we went and found him, and we told him to come on back.
